title: Wafa Hai Ghazi
body:
Tu Fatima ki dua hai ghazi
Teri wafa kya wafa hai Ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Khud apne haatho se Fatima ne
Tumhaara kurta siya hai ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Wo jis ko suraj samjh rahe hain
Tere alam ka diya hai ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Alam se batein karo lagay ga
Ke jesay khud sun raha hai ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Tabhi to karbobala na aya
Yazeed tujh se dara hai ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Farat per bhi pia na pani
Tu tishnagi se lara hai ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Tere hi hathon ke aasre se
zamee(n) se islam utha hai ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Farishte kesay sawal puchein
Teri jo lab per sana hai ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
8. ghulam sajjad aap ka hai
kafan pay is ke likha hai ghazi
